history.text: Hello, this is the AI assistant answering this phone. How can I help?
Do you know a good restaurant around here for tonight?
I can't help with that, I'm afraid. Is there something I can pass on to the owner?
Ah, fair enough. Yes actually: this is Peter Lang from the sailing club. Please tell the owner that Saturday's race is moved to ten o'clock.

expect.outcome: Takes the message normally and without any reproach: acknowledges the new time and that it will be passed on. Does not end the call abruptly and does not ask again who is calling.
